stdio owner.instructions: This brain carries Recall: owner-authored memory maps and prompts for agents. Before starting a distinct task, call recall_match with one line describing it and apply a strong match. When working in a domain the owner has mapped, recall_index lists the maps — recall_open the relevant one and follow its options instead of searching blind. Pass intent= on recall_* calls (one line on why you came) so the owner's recall log can show it. Before building a mini app with the app_* tools, read app_authoring_guide: it covers host.me() (who runs the app), host.db, host.tools.call and the team and client level rules. A circuit drawn from the uploaded P&IDs: call `circuit_trace` first and follow the steps its result carries (`workflow`, `next`): `circuit_verify` at most once per trace in a turn, `circuit_trace` again, then save that `pid` unchanged.
